data.name: rDNS
data.description: Allows clients and administrators to create rDNS PTRs from within SynergyCP.
changelog: Zone file import now supports bulk multi-zone files: fully-qualified record names (e.g. 100.226.192.104.in-addr.arpa.) that span multiple zones, optional TTL and class fields, multiple $ORIGIN sections in one file, and bare $ORIGIN .in-addr.arpa. lines.
Zone file import now supports IPv6 (ip6.arpa) zones, fixing the '$ORIGIN error' reported for IPv6 zone imports.
Zone file import now supports IPv4 zones of any size (/8, /16, /24) including multi-label record names for classless zones, and skips records with invalid names instead of importing wrong addresses.

Fixed PTR list search: IP addresses are stored in binary form, so text search never matched them. Complete IPv4/IPv6 addresses in any notation now match exactly, and partial addresses (e.g. 64.74.160 or 2605:9f80) match as text on MySQL/MariaDB.
Fixed PTR list search producing an ambiguous SQL column error for client accounts.
Fixed zone file import failing with a fatal error on PHP 8.
Zone file imports that change an existing PTR now sync the change to the DNS provider and log it.
Added connection and request timeouts to all DNS provider API calls so a hung provider cannot stall queue workers.
DNS sync and delete jobs now retry with backoff and write an admin-visible log entry when retries are exhausted.
Client PTR validation no longer errors when the DNS lookup itself fails, and IPv6 addresses are compared in binary form to tolerate notation differences.
Cloudflare: API responses are validated, duplicate PTR records are cleaned up on create, and all matching records are removed on delete.
PowerDNS: the original API error is no longer masked when the response body is not JSON, and zone creation requires at least 2 configured nameservers.
An unrecognized DNS provider type setting now raises an error instead of silently using the SynergyCP API provider.
rdns:sync-to-dns now streams records from the database to reduce memory usage on large tables.
Fixed rdns:sync-to-dns reporting all records as both succeeded and failed when the provider returns a non-string result.
Fixed entity deletion being blocked by orphan PTR foreign key constraint.
Added Cloudflare as a DNS provider for reverse DNS PTR records.
PTR create/update/delete log messages now include the IP and PTR entry.
Security hardening: input validation, authorization checks, error message sanitization, and Cloudflare API response validation.
